items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Las Vegas: TE Brock Bowers (ankle) day-to-day, less serious than feared, has a shot to play. QUESTIONABLE - DE Kwity Paye (neck). OUT last week - DT Thomas Booker IV, WR Dont'e Thornton Jr. Fernando Mendoza starts.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Denver (off a bye): WR Jaylen Waddle and CB Riley Moss (concussions) expected back after the bye. OUT before bye - S Brandon Jones, S Talanoa Hufanga, CB Kris Abrams-Draine. IR - RB RJ Harvey, LB Jonah Elliss. Bo Nix starts.
